name: goplusplus
note: Pokémon GO Plus +, ASIN B0BX2P43PX — `<title>Amazon.com: Pokemon Go Plus + : Electronics</title>`. Captured 2026-08-03 at rung 1 (impersonated HTTP, no browser), HTTP 200, 1,893,079 B raw. THE STATE IT REPRESENTS IS THE POINT: the only offer on the page is a USED unit sold by `LO Store (We Record Serial Numbers To avoid FRAUD)` at $219 against a $54.99 MSRP, through Amazon's used buy box — `<input id="add-to-cart-button-ubb" value="Add to cart">`, `id="usedbuyBox"`, `#availability` reading `Only 10 left in stock - order soon.` This is verbatim the alert this project exists not to send, and it is a real page rather than a synthetic one. Amazon ships no structured data on /dp/ (zero application/ld+json, no __NEXT_DATA__), so the DOM reader is the only reader there is. PROVENANCE, stated because it differs from every other fixture here: these are the bytes of THIS repo's first live request to an Amazon product page, made through `boty.fetch.get` at 13:31:19Z and saved outside the repo at the time. `boty capture-fixture` was then run for this ASIN at 13:39:47Z, 12 s after the control capture rather than the 20 s the plan's politeness budget requires, and Amazon answered with its automated-access interstitial — HTTP 200, 3,781 B, no BLOCK_PHRASES match at the time. That capture was deleted rather than committed and the earlier full-page bytes were used instead, so no further request was spent: 5 of the 6 budgeted requests, and the last one was not needed. REDACTED BEFORE COMMIT by class: every <script> body emptied, every <style> body emptied, every HTML comment dropped, session/csrf/offer-listing/timestamp input values blanked, request ids and 3-7-7 session ids replaced, and Amazon's geolocation of this host (`Redacted` x3, `00000` x3) replaced with REDACTED. `bytes` is the redacted size; the raw figure is in this note.
